activities_top.name: Fort Goryokaku and Former Magistrate's Office
activities_top.hours: Park open; Magistrate's Office 9:00-18:00 (until 17:00 Nov-Mar), last entry 15 min before closing

closed.irregular: Magistrate's Office closed Dec 31-Jan 3 and a few irregular days; park always open

activities_top.name: Motomachi District
activities_top.hours: Old Public Hall Apr-Oct 9:00-18:00 (until 19:00 Sat-Mon), Nov-Mar 9:00-17:00; Old British Consulate 9:00-19:00 (until 17:00 Nov-Mar); Orthodox Church weekdays 10:00-17:00, Sat 10:00-16:00, Sun 13:00-16:00

closed.irregular: Old Public Hall closed Dec 31-Jan 3 and a few irregular days; Old British Consulate closed over New Year; Russian Orthodox Church closed Dec 26 to mid March

activities_top.name: Mount Hakodate (Ropeway and Observatory)
activities_top.hours: Ropeway every 15 min: 10:00-22:00 from late April to September; 10:00-21:00 from October 1 to about April 19 (last ascent 20:50)

closed.irregular: Ropeway stops for statutory maintenance once a year (Oct 20-Nov 8 in 2026) and in strong wind

editions.note: Tree illumination 16:30-17:45 and 18:00-22:00 (Dec 1 from 18:00); daily tree lighting with fireworks at 18:00; tree turns red for 15 min at 18:30, 19:30 and 20:30; Hakodate Bay area by the red brick warehouses
